solution_title: On-Demand Local Services & EV Roadside Dispatch
summary: Seattle-centered EV fast-charging and roadside auto-service locator & dispatch architecture using strictly modern, non-deprecated Google Maps Platform APIs. On load, the app initializes a 2D vector map centered on Downtown Seattle (47.6062, -122.3321) with mapId="DEMO_MAP_ID" and internalUsageAttributionIds=["gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0"], places a draggable driver breakdown AdvancedMarkerElement with a configurable 5km-15km proximity Circle (default 10km), reverse-geocodes the driver pin via Geocoder, discovers nearby EV charging stations (electric_vehicle_charging_station) and auto repair providers (car_repair) via Places API (New) (including evChargeOptions connector counts/kW and regularOpeningHours), ranks all results by live driving ETA via Routes API RouteMatrix, and draws the selected dispatch route polyline plus turn-by-turn steps via Routes API Route.computeRoutes. Pure client stacks use Maps JS API importLibrary(...) wrappers exclusively; full-stack BFF stacks (Next.js, FastAPI, Node.js Express) additionally route Places/Routes/Geocoding calls through local /api/* endpoints with explicit X-Goog-Api-Key and X-Goog-FieldMask headers.
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (Map, Circle, AdvancedMarkerElement, PinElement, Polyline, InfoWindow)
seed_search_query: EV charging stations and auto repair providers near Downtown Seattle, WA
ui_layout_summary: Responsive full-viewport split-screen dispatch dashboard (100vh): (1) Top Header Bar (64px) with app title, PlaceAutocompleteElement (gmp-select listener) to relocate the driver breakdown location, reverse-geocoded driver address pill, category filter pills (All, EV Fast Charging, Auto Repair), and radius selector (5 km / 10 km / 15 km); (2) Left Dispatch Sidebar (400px desktop, stacked drawer on mobile) showing live count, ETA-ranked provider/station cards (each showing name, category badge, star rating + review count, live EV connector availability/kW rate or open-hours status badge without calling beta-only place.isOpen() on weekly channel, calculated driving distance + ETA, and 'Route Here' button), plus an active Route Summary & collapsible Turn-by-Turn Maneuver Steps panel when a provider is selected; (3) Right Interactive Map Pane (flex: 1, min-height: 520px) rendering the draggable driver AdvancedMarkerElement, dynamic 5km-15km google.maps.Circle proximity ring, clickable category-colored AdvancedMarkerElement pins for EV stations and mechanics (listening to 'click' on marker element for weekly-channel safety), InfoWindow preview, and active Route Polyline fitted to bounds. All DOM updates in vanilla JS avoid innerHTML/outerHTML in favor of createElement/textContent/replaceChildren, and all servers bind to 127.0.0.1 with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Server-side BFF proxy for Places API (New) Nearby Search to discover EV charging stations (electric_vehicle_charging_station) and auto repair providers (car_repair) within the driver's 5km-15km search circle.
Server-side BFF proxy for Places API (New) Text Search fallback/query refinement (e.g., EV fast charging or mobile roadside mechanic queries biased to Seattle).

Server-side BFF proxy for Routes API Compute Route Matrix to compute real traffic-aware driving distance and ETA from the driver's breakdown pin to all discovered EV stations and auto repair providers for ETA sorting.

Server-side BFF proxy for Routes API Compute Routes to return the encoded dispatch/navigation polyline, total distance/duration, and turn-by-turn maneuver instructions to the selected provider or charging station.

backend_proxy_endpoints.field_mask: N/A (Geocoding REST API uses query params: latlng, result_type=street_address|premise|route)
backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Server-side BFF proxy for Geocoding API reverse geocoding when the driver drags the breakdown pin or clicks on the map to update their pickup/breakdown address.
